title: Women in Wine The Montréal Wine Bar Walking Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A perfect apéro with new friends around a few cheeky day drinks.

We visit four wine bars, buvettes and cavistes. Learn about the ladies who make the wine we will be tasting. Get the skinny on the Women in Wine scene in Québec and visit their establishments to hear their stories over a few glasses. These are small, cozy and exclusive drinking halls as there will be NO OTHER tourist groups here, that's for sure.

We have savoury bites along the way and walk, drink, talk and repeat in a cool hood!

We'll also be walking to check out a bit of the neighborhoods and streets to showcase points of interest and share some stories and even point out the community project ticket sales go to support!

 We hand out a recommendations list for great places to eat and drink in Montréal!
